timers:
Public Sub Note(ByVal s As String)
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).Range("Z1").Value = "'" & Logged() & s & "|"
End Sub
Public Function Logged() As String
    Logged = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).Range("Z1").Value
End Function
Public Sub A()
    Note "A"
End Sub
Public Sub B()
    Note "B"
End Sub
Public Sub WithArgument(ByVal x As Long)
    Note "arg" & x
End Sub
Public Sub Again()
    Note "again"
    Application.OnTime Now, "A"
End Sub
Private Sub Hidden()
    Note "hidden"
End Sub
probe:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
{action}
Probe = Logged()
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe = Logged() & "!E" & Err.Number
End Function
